profile.headline: Experienced Senior Web Developer with a passion for crafting innovative, efficient, and accessible web solutions
profile.summary:
•	Have demonstrated ability to function as a team member and work independently
•	Hardworking, ambitious, dedicated, and will get along with all types of people
•	Excellent writing, verbal, and communication skills
•	Member of Sacramento ColdFusion User Group (SACCFUG) www.saccfung.org
•	Nevada NSF EPSCoR: CIP Entrepreneurship Grant Recipient, 2007
•	General Undergraduate Research Award Grant Recipient, 2007
•	Fluent in speaking Cantonese
•	Proficient with queries, design, and implementation of relational databases
•	Operated large databases of over 50 tables and over 250 million records
•	Working knowledge of procedural, event-driven, and object oriented programming (OOP)
•	Completed Cisco Certified Networking Associate curriculum

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed back-end coding to translate content from CMS to approved website designs and prototypes for main unr.edu site and underlying department sites for Marketing and Communications department.
- Administered and maintained centralized instance of Ingeniux CMS
- Developed and maintained back-end code using C# on the ASP.NET MVC 4 platform.
- Served on ICT Web Accessibility Committee and Website subcommittee to create policies and recommendations to ensure university ADA web compliance with WCAG 2.0, AA Level
- Primary developer on the 2014 University Website Redesign. Moved legacy code from XSLT to C# and integrated a 3rd party vender design to rebuild university site to a mobile friendly design.
- Worked on the 2019 University web rebuild where we upgraded to a new instance of Ingeniux CMS V10 and manually revisited all pages and pieces of content on the site for accessibility  and content relevance. Implemented new coding procedures to ensure high reusability of components and accessibility checks from design, implementation, and testing phases.
- Worked with communications team on rebuilding/redesigning university news site (Nevada Today) to better serve university communications, story telling, and PR building.

positions.title: Business Web Developer
positions.description:
Design and developed web applications that increase business intelligence and efficiency using ColdFusion and Flex.
•	Designed, programmed, and maintained web applications on Intranet Site using ColdFusion and Flex with MS SQL Server (2005, 2008)
•	Provided data analysis for operations managers to assist in forecasting, decision making, and statistics for quarterly business reviews
•	Responsible for MS SQL databases including direct contact with corporate DBA. Responsibilities included query optimization, database design, creating views and stored procedures
•	Worked with 3rd party venders to acquire data feeds and develop automated EDI protocols
•	Created customer dashboards in Flex to report key performance indicators. This included integrating data from multiple sources such as Oracle, XML, and 3rd party API's
•	Designed and modeled applications to improve efficiency in warehouse operations 
•	Managed ColdFusion development projects with a team of five developers

positions.title: Lab Manager and IT Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Managed, maintained, and installed computers for School of Mines using a variety of tools such as Symantec Ghost and Deep Freeze
•	Provided desktop support for administrative staff and grad students
•	Reorganized and rebuilt server hierarchy for Geography Department Servers
•	Maintained Geography department website

positions.title: Senior Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
•	Provided technical support to users over phone and in person
•	Trained, evaluated, and managed lab attendants and help desk student workers
•	Provided 2nd tier support
•	Designed web applications for the User Services department to improve training, knowledge base, and support in managing work schedules for student workers
•	 Created training documents and troubleshooting guidelines

educations.degreeName: BS in Computer and Informational Engineering
educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Information Systems, Math, Business Administration

projects.title: University Website Responsive Redesign
projects.description: I worked closely in a small team where I assisted with custom .NET development in C# which included but was not limited to: development that met department standards, debugging, testing, re-factoring of code, and an ongoing effort to ensure that the website met the accessibility standards set forth by section 508 of the rehabilitation act.
